title: 第二十三章 纵地金光虎先锋第二十四章 辟寒辟暑辟尘大王
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
他想到了纵地金光。
在后世的道教典籍和小说中，纵地金光是一门赫赫有名的遁行神通。
不同于腾云驾雾要借云气。
不同于驾鹤骑鹿要借坐骑。
不同于御剑飞行要借法宝。
纵地金光是以自身化作一道金光，贴地而行，速度之快远超寻常遁术。
更妙的是，这种遁法不入天、不腾空，始终贴着大地行走，与地脉灵气息息相关。
吴耀心中忽然敞亮了。
他将百目金光神通的运转法门、大地意境中领悟的借地脉之力、以及后世对纵地金光的描述。
三者放在一处互相印证，彼此参照，一个前所未有的神通框架在他神魂深处渐渐成形。
这门遁术以金光为体，以地脉为基。
施展之时，不腾云，不驾雾，不借任何外物，整个人化作一道金光没入大地，顺着地脉灵气的流向而行。
地脉是大地的经脉，贯穿山川河岳，连通四海八荒。
只要是有大地的地方便有地脉，有地脉的地方便是这门遁术的通途。
金光入地，便如游鱼入海，速度之快远非寻常遁光可比。
穿山入石更是等闲。
土石对寻常遁光来说是障碍，对这道金光来说却是通途。
金光本就以至阳至刚为性，配合大地之力的加持。
寻常山石在金光面前不过是一层稍厚些的水幕，一穿即过。
阵法屏障、结界禁制也拦不住这道金光，因为它不是强行破开禁制，而是顺着地脉从禁制底下穿过去。

再强的阵法也有根基，根基扎在大地之上，而大地之下便是他的金光通途。
狂风、水火之类的禁制更是拦不住他。
金光本体是以他的百目金光凝练而成。
至阳至刚，水火不侵，况且他颚下还有那颗定风珠，风之禁制在定风珠面前形同虚设。
三者叠加，这门纵地金光一旦练成，天下之大无处不可去。
吴耀将这门神通的框架在神魂深处反复推演了数遍。
将每一个细节都打磨到不能再打磨的地步，才缓缓停了下来。
他心中清楚，眼下推演出的还只是理论。
一个搭建在百目金光和大地之道之上的完美框架。
真正要将它修炼成形，还需要漫长的时间和无数次实战的打磨。
他也清楚，这门纵地金光目前还无法与道门正统的纵地金光相提并论。
道门正统的纵地金光乃是元始天尊所传玉虚宫嫡系神通。
content_en:
He thought of Zongdi's golden light.
In later Taoist classics and novels, Zongdi Jinguang is a well-known magical power of escape.
It is different from riding on the clouds by borrowing the cloud energy.
It is different from riding a crane and riding a deer, where you need to borrow a mount.
Unlike flying with a sword, you need to borrow a magic weapon.
The vertical golden light turns itself into a golden light and travels close to the ground. The speed is far faster than ordinary escape techniques.
What's even better is that this escape method does not enter the sky or soar into the air, but always walks close to the earth, which is closely related to the spiritual aura of the earth's veins.
Wu Yao's heart suddenly became bright.
He described the method of operating the magical power of the Hundred Eyes of Golden Light, the power of borrowing earth veins that he understood in the artistic conception of the earth, and the description of the golden light that spans the earth in later generations.
The three were put together to confirm and refer to each other, and an unprecedented magical power framework gradually took shape deep in his soul.
This escape technique uses golden light as its body and earth veins as its foundation.
When performing it, without soaring into the clouds, riding on the mist, or borrowing any external objects, the whole person turns into a golden light and sinks into the earth, following the flow of the earth's spiritual energy.
Earth veins are the meridians of the earth, running through mountains and rivers, connecting the four seas and the wilderness.
As long as there is earth, there will be earth veins, and the place with earth veins will be the gateway to this escape technique.
When the golden light enters the ground, it is like a fish entering the sea, and its speed is far beyond the comparison of ordinary escape light.
It is even easier to walk through mountains and rocks.
Earth and rocks are obstacles to ordinary escaping light, but they are a thoroughfare to this golden light.
The golden light is inherently yang and strong in nature, and cooperates with the blessing of the power of the earth.
Ordinary rocks are just a slightly thicker water curtain in front of the golden light, which can be passed through as soon as it passes through.
Formation barriers and enchantment restrictions cannot stop this golden light, because it does not forcefully break through the restrictions, but passes under the restrictions along the earth's veins.
No matter how strong the formation is, it has a foundation. The foundation is rooted in the earth, and under the earth is his golden light path.
Restrictions such as strong wind, water and fire cannot stop him.
The body of golden light is condensed from his hundred eyes of golden light.
He is extremely yang and strong, and cannot be invaded by water or fire. Moreover, he still has the Wind-fixing Pearl under his chin, so the restriction of wind is useless in front of the Wind-fixing Pearl.
The three of them are superimposed. Once this golden light is mastered, there is no place in the world that cannot go anywhere.
Wu Yao deduced the framework of this magical power several times deep in his soul.
After polishing every detail to the point where it could no longer be polished, it slowly stopped.
He knew in his heart that what he was deducing right now was just a theory.
A perfect framework built on the golden light of hundreds of eyes and the way of the earth.
It will take a long time and countless actual battles to truly cultivate it into shape.
He also knew that this vertical golden light was currently not comparable to the orthodox vertical golden light of the Taoist sect.
The orthodox golden light of the Taoist sect is the direct lineage of the Yuxu Palace magical power passed down by Yuanshi Tianzun.
